_comment: Sprite sheet for the cybernetic bee particle layer. 16 frames in a 4x4 grid (1024x1024 source, 256x256 per frame). SDXL renders an isolated bee on transparent black; the workflow makes 16 generations with slightly different wing-flap phases via seed walk. The runbook composites them into one PNG atlas using ImageMagick (already installed).

inputs.text: tiny cybernetic bee, chrome and matte black exoskeleton, neon honey gold (#f5b800) thorax stripes glowing, translucent holographic wings with subtle motion blur, cyan accent on the rear LED, top-down 45 degree action pose facing right, isolated on solid black background for chroma keying, sharp silhouette, no shadows, no environment, vector-game-asset clarity, single subject in frame, centered, plenty of margin
multiple bees, swarm, environment, flowers, honeycomb in frame, hands, humans, photo realism, soft focus, watercolor, painting, oversaturated, beige, brown, dusty, watermark, text

21._comment: Single batch_size=16 sampler. Frame variation handled by the model's natural seed-walk inside the batch dim.

40._comment: Saves all 16 frames with sequential indices. Runbook step: `magick montage mixhive-bee-frame_*.png -tile 4x4 -geometry +0+0 -background none public/art/bee-swarm.png`.
